title: Implement filesystem transactions and cross-process locks

checks.name: real_staging
checks.result: Filesystem-backed transactions write UTF-8/LF artifacts beneath scene/staging/generation_id, reject unsafe paths, hash every artifact, and publish a validated immutable commit manifest.

checks.name: atomic_replace
checks.result: Same-volume staging promotion and atomic JSON pointer replacement expose only complete commit and delivery versions; previous versions remain intact and stale parents cannot overwrite current.

checks.name: multiprocess_collision
checks.result: Cross-process lock records are atomically published, ownership is token-bound, stale takeover requires an expired lease plus dead PID plus no active commit marker, and a 10-run collision stress test produced exactly one winner per run.

checks.name: crash_recovery
checks.result: Recovery promotes only one complete parent-matching candidate, repairs a missing delivery pointer from a valid current commit, marks incomplete staging abandoned, and blocks ambiguous candidates.
